text:
cass: FYI — we saw ~2% of /v1/infer requests get sampled but their bodies never show up in the inspect console. console shows sampled=0 for that route while our logs show sampling decisions made upstream. 

mike: hmm, is that the quota-throttle path where sampled events get dropped when route quota is exceeded? :thinking_face: 

julia: not exactly. I dug a bit: sampling decision happens at the API edge and we attach sample=true. downstream router then applies rate quota and sometimes ACKs without forwarding payload. the inspector only counts forwarded samples. 

cass: right — so from a user/console POV it looks like "no samples", even though we made the decision and redaction may have happened already. that's misleading for audits. 

sam: can you paste the relevant snippet of the route config that controls this? might be a small bug. 

julia: sure — here's the k8s-config we use for that pool: 
```
routes:
  - path: /v1/infer
    sample_policy: dynamic
    sample_override_header: X-RDW-SAMPLE
    quota_bucket: realtime-heavy
    forward_sample_payload: true
```

mike: forwarding is true but when quota_bucket is exhausted we short-circuit with HTTP 202 and drop body. ops-bot should have emitted a metric for "dropped_forwarded_sample" but looks like we only increment for full-request drops, not sampled-forward drops. 

ops-bot: metric alert muted: missing_metric(dropped_forwarded_sample) suggested. See playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/sampling-visibility 

cass: proposal: 1) add a counter for forwarded-sample-drops (route-level) 2) expose sampled_decision != forwarded_count in console with small red flag 3) ensure redaction step runs before short-circuit so we never drop a sensitive payload unanonymized. 

sam: +1 on the metric. for the console UX we should show three numbers: decisions / forwarded / visible (post-redact). that would help operators understand if we lost payloads between steps. 

mike: the tricky part is ordering — we currently redact at the collector which only runs if body forwarded. moving redact earlier means edge does redaction and we need KMS access there (compliance/security concern). 

julia: agreed. alternative: keep redact at collector but always forward a minimal redact-sig (HMAC of sensitive fields) when quota prevents full forward. then console can show redaction-sig present but no body. that avoids moving KMS. 

cass: hmm, redact-sig helps audit but doesn't help for cases where audit requires the scrubbed sample. legal might push back. need guidance from privacy/legal. @sam can you loop them in? 

sam: looping legal — pinging @legal-team. In the meantime, I'll open a small RFC to add the metric and console flag (low risk). Will include config example and migration path. 

mike: can we add a short-term debug toggle in console to "force-forward-sampled" for a tenant so SRE can verify rollout? with a strict TTL and audit trail. 

julia: yes, add as an operator-only feature behind RBAC and an audit log entry. config: 
```json
{ "route": "/v1/infer", "force_forward_sample": true, "ttl_seconds": 300, "reason": "canary-debug-2026-03" }
```

cass: perfect. thanks. sam — once RFC is up can you post the link here and assign owners? we'll need eng-privacy + eng-sre + console-ux. 

sam: will do. RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/5782-sampling-visibility-console (draft) — assigning julia, mike, cass. 

ops-bot: created task T-9812: add_metric:dropped_forwarded_sample, route_console_panel, force_forward_toggle -> assignees [julia,mike,sam] 

mike: quick note — when implementing the metric make sure the label keys include tenant_id and route; otherwise our aggregation makes it useless. 

julia: good call. also record whether redaction step ran (boolean label). 

cass: ok team — status: implement metric + console flag + debug toggle as short-term; legal check before changing redaction location. follow-up: we'll re-evaluate moving redaction earlier if legal signs off. :thumbsup:
